author: Gundham
body:
Map Name: Sand Ocean.
Map Creators: Blazikenite & Salamencite.
Map Gamemode: Capture the Wool.

Hey. After a looong time I've decided to make a map. In this case, I didn't exactly make a new one, instead I used Funky Factory and revamped it completely. The map contains void regions in between lanes and wool rooms, underground bedrock walls, soulsand in the floor to annoy everyone, region-protected wool rooms, height limit to prevent ungodly skybridges and most importantly no diamonds.

Here's some pictures:
